sources.notes: The portal's published POST search form filtered by its explicit A00005/국방부 control. Publisher is the government portal; issuer is the page's explicit MND label. Collect the linked HWPX document only; HWP, PDF, multi-attachment and HTML-only variants remain unsupported and are failures, not missing publications. The complete supported document's text, HTML and HWPX bytes are preserved separately. Portal posting date is preserved; any date inside the document stays original text and does not replace it. This is not direct MND-site retrieval, a complete MND wire, Joint Chiefs/service coverage, or independent corroboration. Tier B reflects republication. Cadence thresholds remain unset.
